title: Kanishka I
hook: Kanishka I: Shaka Samvat (78 CE) aur chautha Bauddh sammelan

facts.Pehchan: Shaka Samvat (78 CE) aur chautha Bauddh sammelan

exam_points: Chauthi Bauddh Sangiti Kundalvana (Kashmir) mein; adhyaksh Vasumitra, upadhyaksh Ashvaghosha.
Mahayana Bauddh dharm ka sanrakshak; Gandhara aur Mathura kala.
Darbar ke vidwan: Ashvaghosha, Nagarjuna, Charaka, Vasumitra (parampara).
